repository.name: agid-postal-af
repository.purpose: Afghanistan postal-context contract seed for an independent country-data repository linked to AGID

postal_system.transition_rule: The UPU Afghanistan addressing sheet dated 07/2025 states that the new six-digit postcode system came into force on 1 October 2024. The first two digits encode one of 34 provinces in the range 10-43; the middle two encode city districts 01-50 or rural districts 51-99; the final two encode postal delivery zones 01-99. Legacy four-digit values are not accepted by the current runtime.
postal_system.assignment_rule: Store the current postcode as a six-character digit string preserving leading zeroes within components. Production assignment requires an exact current Afghan Post response or legally authorised rights-cleared release with code, object type, authority, validity, retrieval timestamp, response schema and digest pinned. UPU examples, address searches, post offices, P.O. boxes, OCHA or NSIA administrative P-codes, province or district names, coordinates, roads, OSM and models do not independently create an assignment.
postal_system.geometry_rule: The current Afghan Post Postal Code System can return postal-area GeoJSON for a code, but no production response or bulk geometry is bundled. Official geometry requires an exact Afghan Post response or release with assignment relation, schema, validity, terms, CRS, topology and digest pinned. OCHA COD-AB province or district boundaries and P-codes remain administrative context; joining them to a proven assignment creates only a derived postal-administrative surface with uncertainty. Voronoi, interpolation, HOT, OSM and models never become official postal geometry.
postal_system.address_rule: Recipient, organisation, premise number, street or thoroughfare, locality or village, building and floor information, city or rural district, province, P.O. Box, postcode and coordinates remain typed, sourced and validity-aware. A postcode, map response, post office, administrative P-code, coordinate, road, building footprint or proximity alone does not identify a recipient, owner, occupant, entrance, unit, exact legal civic address or delivery entitlement.
postal_system.building_rule: Building display requires an explicit rights-cleared civic-address identifier, a stable reviewed relation to a building identifier, and separately permitted building geometry with purpose, validity, privacy, CRS and digests pinned. Afghan Post search fields, UPU examples, OCHA boundaries, HOT or OSM buildings are not an automatic address-building relation. Postal or administrative containment, coordinate equality and nearest-building logic are candidates or validation evidence only.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index. A postal assignment, official or derived surface, address point or building may link to AGID cells through an explicit versioned crosswalk without relabelling a postcode, administrative P-code, province, district, delivery zone, post office, P.O. Box, address or building as an AGID cell, or claiming AGID geometry is Afghan Post geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: Pin publisher, exact page, response, item or service URL, publication and download dates, terms or licence version, attribution, schema, fields, CRS and digest for every production artifact. Afghan Post states all rights reserved, and its public map, search endpoints and policy page do not grant blanket bulk postcode, address, coordinate, polygon or building redistribution rights. OCHA COD-AB may be used only under its exact CC BY 3.0 IGO attribution and version terms; ODbL sources remain separate.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Recipients, senders, address and postcode queries, home or premise numbers, private coordinates, P.O. Box holders, phone or email, identities, residents, owners, occupants, tenants, access credentials and private premises are excluded from public artifacts. Exact lawful authority, purpose limitation, minimisation, retention and publication approval are required before operational Afghan Post or partner address data enter a production pack.
